question: In a certain code language, 'NOSTRIL' is written as 'TSRONLI', and 'PLAY' is written as 'YPLA'. How will 'FLUIDITY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e690c12a66adaf209adf0b1ff008bb704c48783bd537b818e9d442fb16b230.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• NOSTRIL

 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: T > S > R > O > N > L > I
 
• Therefore, code = TSRONLI
 
 
 
• PLAY
 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: Y > P > L > A
 
• Therefore, code = YPLA
 
 
 
• FLUIDITY
 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: Y > U > T > L > I = I > F > D
 
• Therefore, code = YUTLIIFD
 
 

Hence, '**YUTLIIFD**' is the correct answer.
